CLucene Mobile changes from the existing CLucene 2.3.3.4 mobile checkout
=====================================================================

Recorded: 2026-10-12
This is a downstream mobile port, not an official new CLucene release.

Build and packaging changes
---------------------------
- Moved core, shared, and contributor sources under src/core, src/shared,
  and src/contribs while retaining the internal CLucene include hierarchy.
- Replaced separately maintained Xcode and ndk-build definitions with one
  explicit CMake source list and platform presets.
- Added a CLucene.h umbrella header, installation rules, CMake package metadata,
  and an optional in-memory indexing/search smoke test.
- Added arm64 iOS-device and arm64 iOS-simulator static-library builds and
  XCFramework packaging. Default deployment target: iOS 15.6, using libc++.
- Added future Android arm64-v8a and x86_64 NDK configurations; no claim of
  tested Android support is made here.
- Made highlighter optional and disabled by default. Other contributor
  implementations are preserved but not enabled.
- Excluded the unused incomplete FilterResultCache.cpp implementation and the
  incomplete bundled deflate.cpp. The build links SDK/NDK zlib instead.

Configuration changes
---------------------
- Moved the two CLucene configuration headers into CMake templates, with
  generated copies isolated per build directory.
- Disabled the obsolete ext/hash_map feature definition and replaced the
  std::tr1 hashing namespace definition with std. The inherited hashing-disabled
  behavior and wchar_t-based Unicode mode remain unchanged.

Implementation changes
----------------------
- QueryParserTokenManager.cpp: replaced out-of-range 64-bit bitmask initializers
  with representable signed -1 and -2 values, retaining the intended bit patterns.
- QueryParser.cpp: replaced out-of-range 0x80000000 signed-array initializers
  with the representable signed 32-bit minimum expression.
- These changes address C++11 narrowing diagnostics without suppressing them.

Attribution changes and limitations
----------------------------------
- Added binary-package NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt documents, including
  CLucene, GLib-derived code, Gary McNickle/RSA MD5, historical Unicode 4.0 UCD
  Terms of Use, and additional current Unicode license information.
- Kept the top-level Apache License 2.0 text unchanged.
- Separated the repository-wide Markdown inventory from the binary notices in
  docs/distribution/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt and updated the packaging path.
- Added module-local license texts and dated provenance records for contributors,
  MD5, Unicode/GLib-derived code, and the preserved zlib 1.2.3 deflate source.
- Historical Unicode 4.0 UCD terms were located in the official release archive;
  exact table derivation/provenance reconciliation remains open.
  See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt before publishing this package.
- No upstream SWORD or PocketSword changes are part of this package.

This is a change summary, not a build manifest, legal clearance, or a guarantee
that these modifications have passed full application-level runtime testing.
